batting.name: M Vohra
batting.dismissal: c D Wiese b MA Starc

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b S Aravind

balls.text: manages to turn a leg-stump yorker into a boundary, does he? No, long leg has raced across to his left and kept it to a single. The scoop helps him again and he walks off with AB's arm over his shoulder. How bout that for a 17-year old!
first move was his back leg going way outside leg, and then AB leaps way to the off side for a sweep. Doesn't connect. Leg bye
yorker on middle, jams it through point

scoops, but it ends up at the third man boundary! It's kinda like how AB does it, when he sets up for the scoop and then realises the line is full and outside off, so he just opens a face a tad and secures a brilliant boundary
yorker outside leg, whipped through his legs through to long leg

around the wicket, nails it nice and full on middle, clipped into the leg side for a quick single. Anureet goes for a throw and hits Sarfaraz as he is scurrying to make his ground. Apology immediately given and accepted
good length ball outside off, but AB doesn't care as he lunges forward and sweeps again to bisect long leg and deep square leg. Terrific placement
low full toss on middle, swept away powerfully to deep square leg. Kings Xi's bowlers are coming undone over after over
drilled down the ground, but Axar has pushed his right foot out and absorbs AB's big hit
this is length, and AB has stayed beside it to pump it straight down the ground. Thumped
tossed up, rather slow which is finally good to see, AB goes for a sweep and misses
shortish and outside off, slapped to deep point

fuller and outside off, Safaraz goes for a scoop and gets it off the outside edge, flies away down to long leg where Anureet is rushing in. Full-length dive, but he isn't able to get his hands under it
whips a fuller delivery off middle between deep square leg and deep midwicket

clatters into the base of middle stump! His yorkers have been a revelation this season, along with Bhuvi from Sunrisers. DK was moving outside leg to smear it through the covers but it sneaks under his bat
low full toss, DK has put all he has into it and despite the ball hitting a bit high on the bat, it clears long-on. Just a happy little golf swing
hits the yorker a shade outside off, DK squeezes it into the covers and grabs a second off the overthrow. Seems to have been a ricochet at the bowler's end, but DK's well home
full and fired in wide of leg stump, flicked to long leg

taken! Stunning return catch! Axar, take a bow! AB, Maxi and Vijay come up and shake hands with him. What an innings! He had hoped to entertain the crowd today and here's what he managed - 117 off 57, seven fours, and 12, that's 1-2.... 12 sixes! This one though didn't get anywhere close to that elevation. Bashes a fuller delivery down the ground with his full Gayle force and Axar, very brave of him, intercepted it!
hits almost the blockhole on middle and leg, keeps him quiet
set up for a huge hut over deep midwicket, admosnishes himself after he only gets an inside edge onto pad. Good, full and flat bowling from Axar. No room given
pushed through on leg stump, clipped to short fine leg
flat, hard, humongous! This was fuller and outside off, Gayle came forward and mowed it over long-off. I think my descriptions should be becoming boring now
cleared his front leg and swiped a fuller, flatter delivery outside leg stump to the deep square leg boundary
pushed through down leg
low full toss outside off, punched to long-off. That'll be the second time out
another low full toss on leg stump, from around the wicket, AB goes for the sweep over fine leg but has to settle for a leg bye into the midwicket region
hits the yorker as AB tries a sweep, doesn't connect well. Weather's a leg before appeal, but the impact was outside leg
slower ball, low full toss outside leg, nudged to deep square leg
fuller delivery on off stump, tries a whip to midwicket. Mistimed for a single

phew! What the heck happened here?! This was a high full toss and AB had set up into the reverse swat - a bit too early - but he adjusts and uses his entire body - a bit of a whippy roll of his torso - to help the ball over short third man, all completely off balance
full toss outside leg, Gayle's got the sweep going as well. That brings up the 50 partnership between these two. I thought they'd been together for about two minutes. Been 3.4 overs...
short and wide, AB has cut it to deep point
and add another chapter. More width, allows the batsman to get under it and AB slices it over cover again. Flat and hard
flighted outside off, AB plants that front foot out and smashes it over extra cover. Murder AB wrote
goes way short and AB has launched it over midwicket. Camped back and swung free. And that length came out because he charged the last ball
runs down the track, but Karanveer has pulled his length back and got it to dip. The lack of turn helps him get an inside edge
full and angled into the pads, AB pulls his front leg back just a touch to unveil a powerfully wristy flick to deep square leg
shortish delivery bowled from around the wicket, AB makes room and cuts to point
slower ball on middle, Gayle covers the line and blocks into the covers. And he actually takes a quick single
slower ball on off stump, Gayle goes back and slices it to point

there it is! Drops his bat and does a little skip, a turn midair, and extends his arms out in triumph and out belts a roar! That's his 14th ton in T20 cricket. All of that comes off a neat little flick past short fine leg
gets a back of a length delivery to stay low. AB was off his feet trying to punch through cover, and gets an inside edge. Ladies and gentleman, the almost extinct AB de Villiers mis-hit
another one! This is on the roof as well! Loads more impact as Gayle cleared that front leg and clattered it away

straight up! But with Gayle's power that will still land over the ropes. Seems like Karanveer had just done enough to get this outside the Gayle's reach. And I doubt if this ball hit anywhere near the middle. But it beat long-on easily
flatter and quicker on off stump, AB slaps it through extra cover and yells "Yeah, yeah, yeah," well before Miller was unable to dive to his right and stop the ball. Boy, this guy knows cricket!
heaved away to Axar at deep midwicket. Was looking aerial again, but mis-hit the ball
slips down leg this time and Gayle doesn't connect with the sweep
lovely, loopy legspinner from Karanveer. Even got a hint of drift. But AB's played a serene cover drive off the middle, of course
shortish and outside off, slapped to deep cover
slips a length ball well wide of Gayle's reach outside off

another low full toss on off stump, tapped to long-on. That's an over Kings XI Punjab needed about as much as Popeye needed spinach with Bluto on the verge of world domination ---- Only four runs and a wicket
full and a shade outside off, pushed down the ground to long-off
goes around the wicket and slings in a low full toss on middle and leg, clipped to deep square leg
a very orthodox drive through the covers against a good length ball outside off. Chinnaswamy roars, "ABD, ABD, ABD!"
kisses the base of middle and off stump! A second straight yorker from Sandeep and this time he gets it through Kohli's defences. Top quality bowling from the young medium-pacer
nails the yorker on off stump and Kohli can't get anything for it. Can only dig it out. Lovely ball

there's another one. Loads of them have come down the ground. Chinnaswamy is breaking the sound barrier here. Just stands there, gets to the pitch of the ball with that humongous bat and smears it over long-on. Spartan's a good name for that bat
flighted outside off, pushed down to long-off.
good length ball on off stump, defended
pushed through full on leg stump, heaved away off the inside edge to deep square leg
fired in flat and quick on off stump, beaten by pace and gets an inside edge onto pad

down on one-knee and thumped onto the roof! The ball ricochets down to Maxwell at long-on, who takes it and asks for a catch. At least they're still in good spirits. Gully rule don't apply even in IPL, I'm afraid
ends up with a full toss down the leg side. Gayle tries a tickle, but can't get bat to it
drummed down to long-on to retain strike
kept out as this is speared at his legs
fired into the blockhole at off stump, Gayle slaps it back at the bowler and Maxi tempts the crowd. Throws the ball in the air as if he'd taken a catch, but the Bangalore crowd are unmoved.
slid down the leg side, Gayle misses the sweep

encore! This is into the second tier of the stands behind long-off. Gets down the track to make his own length and hammers it through the line. All Maxi can do is offer an apology to his captain.  Hundred-run stand brings out the usual Kohli-Gayle handshake and blow-it-up
in the slog and Gayle has deposited it into the crowd over long-on, who are already in the highest states of delirium. Massive bat, massing bat swing, massive six
flights it round-armed outside off, swiped to long-on
stays back and punches a shortish delivery to long-off
pushed through quick on leg stump, goes for a whip and doesn't connect. Has to settle for a leg bye to fine leg
quite flat on leg stump, punched down to long-on
captain into the chaos! Jumps down the track and thumps a length delivery over the bowler's head, and then the sightscreen as well
flighted outside off, pushed back at the bowler

dropped by Vohra on the square leg boundary! It was in the arc, with the shorter length and the room on offer, Gayle swung it away but didn't quite connect it. Should have been a regulation taken after he moved to his left. Misses. And Gayle indulges in a change of bat
turned away through midwicket to retain strike. So this is what it looks like when he drops anchor
tossed up outside off, slapped down the ground to long-off
driven to long-off. That's 3000 IPL runs for Gayle. A little raise of the bat in acknowledgment. First overseas player to the mark
91kph, good length ball, bowled from around the stumps as well, flicked to midwicket
lots of whip on this fuller delivery on off stump as he sends it to long-on
goes around the stump, the ball goes on with the angle, which Kohli knew very well. He camped way back in his crease and cut a flat, quick, round-armed length ball through point
full on leg stump, whipped to midwicket. They're doing a lot better at tucking him up now
goes short, and despite his slower pace, makes Gayle duck. All because of the line on leg stump, cramping him
slower ball outside off, slid down to deep third man with the open face
back of a length and outside off, Kohli slaps it to the left of point. But Bailey flings himself at it and saves a certain boundary. Can that spark Kings XI? Anureet and MIller clap hard
full on leg stump, clipped to deep midwicket
pace off the ball now with Anureet. Kohli's aggression though continues as he looks to slap a back of a length ball through the covers. Gets an little bit of a bottom edge though
fullish on leg stump, tucked to the left of midwicket. That will be a time out, and I imagine a collective sigh from the Kings XI
143kph, banged in short, but his line's not quite as threatening. Wayward down the leg side
141kph, goes short on middle and off, Kohli sinks to one knee under it and veers his head away
142kph, back of a length on off stump, defended
another full toss, clipped to short fine leg. Lucky for Kings XI. But that is still his fifty, at a strike rate of 227!
this a loopy slower full toss outside off, Gayle goes for a one-handed flick having been beaten by the lack of pace. The ball leaps off the front of the bat and lands one bounce short of point
he's in a mood today! Doesn't care if the ball is short and rearing up towards his shoulder. All he sees is the room to free the arms and he uses that to pummel the ball over midwicket
shortish and skirts down the leg side, appeal from the keeper, joined in by the bowler. Gayle went for a flick, but hasn't connected. So it's a wide
lands the yorker on middle, dug out to long-on
shortish on and around leg stump, Gayle ducks under it. Not called a wide. Marginal, I suppose
nicely done, glides a shortish delivery outside off to deep third man
full on off stump, clipped to short midwicket
skips down the pitch and lifts a back of a length delivery over cover again! Uses that bottom hand so well to get his power, and direction for the ball
back of a lenght slower ball on leg stump, tucked to long leg
dug in short, and it slips away towards the leg side as well. Kohli goes for a pull, and seems to have gloved it. Brings up the RCB 50 in absolutely no time!
moves outside leg and thumps him through the covers! Slight change of pace, and it was a length ball, he made his own line with his footwork, and then clobbered it
143kph, another short ball, another pull, but this time Kohli's beaten for the lack of bounce.
143 kph, beaten on the pull! Too quick for him. Lots of effort behind the ball as he banged it in and got it to lift above Kohli's left shoulder. Not much room either. Top delivery
140kph, fullish on off stump, Kohli gets behind it
140kph, back of a length on middle, tucked towards square leg
phew! That's a top-quality cricket shot! Gets up on his toes behind a back of a length ball and punches it down to the long-off boundary. Imperious
full toss, with width as well, Gayle pummels it over long-on. Such an equal-opportunity hitter, he is
bowls it full on off stump, Kohli keeps back and bottom hands a drill to extra cover
sliced through the covers, and it's a no ball as well. Gayle was almost reluctant to run that single

put down. Bailey was running back after Gayle launches another one into orbit. It came off the bottom of the bat and the captain raced back from mid-off, looking over his shoulder to track the ball. But then he's misjudged it. Dives after the ball but I don't think he got his hands to it

no swing this time and Gayle has monstered it over midwicket! Kicks that front leg out of the way and swings free. LIke how a ball pushed into a revolving door would go, if that door was given mutant powers
fuller delivery on and around off stump, with some inward movement, Kohli goes for an on the up drive and gets an inside edge to long leg
that's where Mitch wants to be - both in pace 144 kph, and in length - it's short and angled on leg stump. Gayle calmly ducks under it
helped away! Gayle's loving the extra pace! And why wouldn't he when the ball's only at knee high? Back of a length delivery, clipped away to the square leg boundary
142 kph, this is even more convincing! Pitched up on off stump, Gayle cleared that front foot a touch and muscles it down the ground. Easily clears the sightscreen
140kph, launched over long-off! Overpitched and it's been sent on its way. All Gayle did was lean into it and shovel the ball over the top
140 kph, camps back, waiting for the short ball. And yet he's slow on it this time. Gets another inside edge to midwicket
off the inside edge! Bowls full, and commits the mistake of offering room to Gayle. He's forward to try and cream it through the covers but was too soon into the stroke. Four through midwicket then
back of a length on middle and leg, Kohli comes at the bowler and taps to mid-on
slants the ball a little further on leg stump in anticipation of the away swing. Gayle blocks awkwardly and nudges to point
fuller length gets him to poke and it nearly  caught the outside edge. Great outswingers here
keeps to his crease and pushes his bat at the ball, but it has other plans. Leaps away off the deck towards the keeper and the single slip
comprehensively squared up this time as Sandeep rips one right past the outside edge of Gayle. Terrific delivery
back of a length and nipping away off the seam, Gayle is squared up a touch as he runs the ball to point
there we have it! Two runs shy of the worst IPL defeat in history. Sandeep gets down the track and yorks himself. Jams his bat down and gives a dolly back to the bowler
watchfully turns a good length ball to deep midwicket. He had danced down, but having not got to the pitch of it,  adjusted well
steps out of his crease, but Yuzi pulls his length back and fires it in quick. Clipped through midwicket
down the track to meet a googly and he's managed good connection. Slugged away over deep midwicket
leading edge as he squares Sandeep up with a back of a length delivery that seams away. Flick shot ends up looping over to deep point
leaps up to handle a rising delivery on middle and chops it to deep point
full and outside off, Sandeep leans forward and drills it to the left of Starc at mid-off. Single taken
back of a length on off stump, a little more ably handled as he guides it to point
back of a length on off stump, Sandeep dabs it off the outside edge to point
starts off with a good length ball on off stump, Axar goes for a heave and ends up with an inside edge. Deflection off his back thigh gets him a single
short on middle, Axar has pulled it quite powerfully to deep square leg
down the track, gets to the pitch and thumps the ball over the long-off boundary. Good footwork, good intent
anothe googly on off stump, defended
goes for a sweep and although it was against the turn - Chahal was bowling the googly - it was on leg stump and it's been placed fine
it's the googly on off stump, Axar realises it so very late and manages to get his bat down in time to protect off stump
flat on middle, swept to square leg on the boundary
feet rooted at leg stump as he pokes outside off and misses the rapid, good length delivery outside off. Ends a phenomenal spell: 4-0-15-4
nearly got another! It was a searing yorker a shade outside off, and that's what helps Sandeep survive.
that's the seventh batsman out bowled! Full, fast, threatening off stump and these aren't idle threats either. Too good for Karanveer
goes short from around the wicket, Karanveer is content to hide inside the line of the ball
squirted off the inside edge and the fuller delivery outside off ends up at deep midwicket
full on off stump, from around the wicket, driven to long-off
another short ball, this time a little more difficult, headed for his head, but Axar has swivelled on the back foot and pulls to the long leg boundary
goes short and Axar has slashed it over third man. Had all the width he could ask for and he takes full toll
lands a yorker on middle, Karanveer clips it to deep square leg
shortish and outside off, sliced to point
back of a length on off stump, pushed to the left of mid-on
good length and outside off, Axar goes for a swipe and misses
shortish on off stump, defended
good length on off stump, slid off the open face past point

another one down! The stumps are in tatters again! Anureet has had a fine day with the ball, conceding only 6.25 amid the carnage, but he walks back with a duck. Swung at a length ball which was just too quick for him
full and curling in at the batsman, who is beaten for pace as he goes for a flick. Mild lbw appeal, would have slid down

buh-bye, and Starc just smiles after messing up the off stump. It was fast, it was straight, it got the slog from the batsman, it beat him and Johnson follows his six other team-mates in making a forlorn walk back to the pavilion
full and wide outside off, Mitch is way outside leg stump and throws his bat at it. Johnson's afraid of Starc's pace. How bout them apples?
back of a length on leg stump, Johnson is lead-footed on leg stump as he blocks
short and wide, invites the cut and it beats the diving point fielder. Easy boundary that

lovely pick up shot! He even managed to get on top of a delivery that was lifting above his stomach, and yet he had firm control over it. No intention to keep it down and a roll of the wrists places it perfectly to the straight midwicket boundary
back of a length and outside off, sliced to point
full toss on middle, clipped to deep square leg
back of a length and outside off, run down to point
lazy drive on the up outside off, Aravind jags the ball back and hurtles through bat and pad to peg off stump. This has become a procession
flighted on off stump, he leans forward to block. Looks like Kings XI have had a change in plans.. And that will be the time out
clipped to short midwicket
good length ball outside off, eased down the ground but not past the ring
that's the googly, Axar reads it off the pitch and glides it to the third man boundary
down the track, but with the flatter trajectory all Bailey can do is push down the ground to long-off
shortish and outside of, punched to Kohli at short cover
top of off knocked back again! Miller runs down and misses a length, slightly slower, ball as he plays outside the line. Bat and pad gap exploited and Chinnaswamy continues to rumble
good length ball on off stump, nudged through midwicket

simply done at mid-on. Kohli moves to his right, eyes on the ball all the way, pouches it and dives with his momentum. No timing on the shot from Saha even as he runs down the track. Goes for a heave, mistimes it because he is rushed into his stroke
full and pushed across the right-hander, who swings searching for extra cover and misses
strays down leg and all he had to do was help it over short fine leg. Came forward and swung it away into vacant areas. More of that for Kings XI
runs down the track to a good length ball and misses on the slog. Poor effort from Saha
inswinging full toss on middle and leg, Miller can't get his whip out quick enough against this 146 kph delivery. Appeal for leg before, but it could be sliding down
not quite short enough for the pull and Saha only gets an inside edge to midwicket. That's how you cramp a batsman. Pacy, right on middle and off
good length ball, punched to extra cover for another quick single. Wiese rushed in to stop it, but he's misfielded
walks at Starc, who swerves a fuller delivery away from Miller's bat swing. Soundly beaten
think he got it off the bottom of the bat. Good plan to hit him straight, but he has trigger finger. Came at the length ball a little too early. Only a single to mid-on
full and outside off, tapped to mid-off for a quick single
short and outside off, sliced to deep third man
whipped away! That's a good shot, perhaps the first of the innings since Saha's six. Got forward to the fuller ball and works it through the vacant midwicket region
shortish and outside off, slugged away to midwicket. Mistimed
beauty! There's swing suddenly! It's pitched on a good length and gathers pace and movement off the pitch. Miller was coming forward with a flick and is handsomely beaten
shortish and a shade outside off, Miller goes for a cut but bottom edge to the keeper

off stump knocked over! Maxi has not looked like the usual Maxi and he falls to an average slog! It was a good length ball angled across. The batsman went across the line with the scoreboard pressure bearing down on him. Misses and Aravind hits. Sets off a la Imran Tahir, roar and all
gets into a tangle as he plays this short one, manages to nudge it away to deep square leg though
another one past the outside edge! Fantastic over. Maxwell wanted to run this down to third man but makes no contact
now he chooses to show some respect. Stays in the crease and defends it down the pitch
another superb delivery! This one is not as full but swings the same way. Beats Maxwell, who was charging down the pitch, and flies over the middle stump
what a corker! This is full and swings away very late. Vijay wanted to whip it through the leg side but this moves away from the blade and takes out the middle stump. That is a one helluva delivery
superb start! He angles it from wide of the crease and keeps the pace quite slow, the batsman has to defend it down the pitch
makes room but gets a slower delivery, ends up chopping it towards Gayle at slip for a single
length delivery flies between the bat and pad as Vijay swings across the line. That wasn't far from the off stump either
this one gets big on Vijay, pushed to cover off the back foot
the bowler slows it down a touch, Saha pushes it through midwicket for a single
there is no time to wait and watch. Saha gets going with a whack over square leg. Just picked up the length early and swiveled into it
bowls this one wide of off, the batsman has to reach out and dabs it towards point
that could have well been given lbw! A yorker spearing on the leg stump line. But instead, Kings XI get four for the overthrow at the non-striker's end
length delivery outside off, the batsman gets beaten for pace

has that been taken! That is a fantastic catch by Wiese. Vohra drove this away from his body, without any timing. The ball was dying on the cover fielder. Wiese, however, dives forward and takes an excellent catch, claims it straight away. As with all the replays of such catches, this is very hard to tell. He might have taken it cleanly, but this  might go against the fielder. It doesn't. Well done, technology. Starc gets me some points straightaway
appeals for a caught and bowled off a ricochet off the boot, but that one grazed the ground too. Fantastic yorker by the way
there comes the fuller inswinging delivery! Vohra was lucky that this came as a low full toss. He inside edges it through to deep backward square leg
gets some swing but this moves down the leg side, gets big on Karthik who is not able to collect it cleanly, this runs down to fine leg
leans forward into this length delivery and slices it down to third man
